source.title: Long queues as diesel shortage hits Lusaka

text:
Long queues as diesel shortage hits Lusaka

Motorists queued for hours in Lusaka on Tuesday as many filling stations ran out of diesel. The Energy Regulation Board said that a delay in fuel imports caused the shortage.

Transporters said that trucks carrying copper to Dar es Salaam waited two days for fuel in Kapiri Mposhi.
